prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Spectrum 2-3: page #FBF9FA, text #2D211F, accent #86851D, secondary surface #E7EFE8, text on accent #111111. Set headings in EB Garamond and reading text in Cotham Sans; literary heading with understated sans text. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 14px, heading 36px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
